learning_outcomes.text: Designs a typical structure, mechanical device, subassembly, or test stand based on initial design assumptions and performance criteria. Uses appropriate analytical methods and computer tools.

Is able to identify, formulate and develop the documentation of a simple design or technological task, including the description of the results of this task in Polish or in a foreign language and to present the results using computer software or other aiding tools. Can specify assumptions for solving a design task, i.e., determine input data such as: the loads, material, environmental constraints, normative guidelines. During design work uses popular engineering programs. Can present the results of work in the form of a presentation or report.

Knows how devices work, can determine the principle or main mechanism of operation of a device. Can compare devices with similar applications mechanically and indicate the advantages and disadvantages of compared devices in terms of utility, safety, environmental, economic and legal criteria.

He has mastered the theoretical foundations of designing individual machine parts and simple mechanical devices. He is able to select components from the manufacturer's catalog. He is able to propose the right material (both in terms of strength and from the point of view of economy and operation) and is able to propose the optimal manufacturing process for the designed part.
Has basic knowledge of statics, kinematics, dynamics and vibration theory required for modeling machine parts, mechanisms, devices and mechanical systems.

syllabus_topics: Presentation of the general theoretical foundations (features, functions, constructional variants, application, etc.) regarding typical groups of machine parts, such as: screw joints, welded joints, shafts and axles, couplings, gears, brakes, bearings, drives, flexible elements.
Acquainted with the basic calculation methods of typical machine elements
assessment_rules: The passing threshold for Design projects, Tests, and Final exam is 56.0%.
bibliography: A set of scripts from the Basics of Machine Design published by the Gdańsk University of Technology
A set of books "Basics of Machine Design" published by PWN, Warsaw
"PKM, t. I, II, III" edited by M. Dietrich, PWN, Warsaw
Any works on the "Basics of Machine Design" in Polish and English
degree: Mechanical Engineering, first-cycle (engineer), specialization Design and Production Engineering
